title: Internship Programme 2027: Data Scientist and Analyst
description:
**About Revolut**
 People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75\+ million customers get more from their money every day.
   

  

 As we continue our lightning\-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000\+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.
   

  

**About The Internship Programme**
 Our Internship Programme is designed for ambitious students who want to make their summer count. Over 8–10 paid weeks, you’ll work on real projects, tackle meaningful challenges, and develop your skills alongside industry experts. It’s an opportunity to learn, innovate, and build a solid foundation for your career.
   

  

 Top performers may be offered a place on our Graduate Programme the following year, giving you the opportunity to return and continue your journey at Revolut.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Our Data Science team solves complex problems with smart, practical solutions. Data Scientists and Analysts work directly with product teams to uncover insights, guide decisions, and improve how customers experience Revolut. They do this by delivering scalable solutions that move the business forward.
   

  

 We’re looking for Data Scientist and Analyst Interns who believe no data task is too complex. You’ll dig into databases, uncover root causes, design smart solutions, and write the code to bring them to life.
   

  

 Up to shape what’s next in finance? Let’s get in touch.
   

  

**Join us from anywhere**
 The Internship Programme is open to international applicants ready to relocate to one of our tech hubs in Poland, Portugal, the UAE, or the UK. We’ll support you with visa assistance, travel costs, and accommodation (conditions apply). You’ll be expected to spend around 3 days per week in the office (where role and location allow).
   

  

**Key dates**
* Applications: open from May 2026
* Recruitment process: July–December 2026
* Programme start: June / July 2027


 Roles are filled on a rolling basis — apply early.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Taking part in a hands\-on bootcamp and working on real projects across multiple teams
* Helping to build analytical tools and machine learning models (such as dashboards and ETLs) to support product launches
* Improving visibility in user sign\-up flows and operational funnels
* Enhancing and maintaining data infrastructure (including ETLs and LookML) to keep data accessible and reliable
* Collaborating with teams across Operations, Growth, and Product to refine features and uncover insights
* Supporting decision\-making with ad\-hoc analysis (e.g., interest rate sensitivity, incentive profitability, conversion rates)
* Learning from industry leaders and staying aligned with team priorities through weekly meetings
* Managing tasks, tracking progress, and communicating key outcomes
* Sharing updates with our global teams
* Receiving regular feedback to guide your development


**What You'll Need**
* To be in your penultimate year of a bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, maths, physics, or a similar field (graduating in 2028\)
* Impressive Python and SQL skills
* An interest or experience in analytics engineering, product analytics, data science, or ML engineering
* A solid foundation in maths and statistics
* A proactive, results\-driven mindset
* Fluency in English
* Great communication, organisational, and problem\-solving skills
* To be comfortable working in a fast\-paced, diverse team environment
* Full\-time availability for summer 2027
* The ability to attend a Revolut office in your country of employment at least 3 days per week (this is a hybrid role)


 Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D\&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard\-working team.
   

  

**Important notice for candidates:**
 Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.
   

  

* Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third\-party services or platforms for our recruitment.
* Always double\-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.


**We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process.** 
 If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

title: Junior Bunker Trader
description:

 You will learn about marine fuel trading and bunker markets, negotiation and deal execution, shipping operations and logistics, pricing and market analysis, customer relationship management, global trading communication etc.
 



 It is a performance\-driven role with significant long\-term earning potential.
 



  





 It will be your responsibility to build your own portfolio of international clients, develop and maintain relationships, operators and suppliers, source and negotiate bunker fuel transactions, monitor fuel market movements and pricing, ensure smooth operations/deliveries, coordinate with credit management, identify new business opportunities, support senior traders in their daily trading activities etc.

title: Investment Associate
location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
description:
**Firm Overview** 




  





 Lunate is a new Abu Dhabi\-based, Partner\-led, independent global alternative investment manager with more than 200 employees and $115 billion of assets under management. Lunate invests across the entire private markets spectrum including buyouts, growth equity, early and late\-stage venture capital, private credit, real assets, and public equities and public credit. Lunate aims to be one of the world’s leading private markets solutions providers through SMAs and multi\-asset class funds, seeking to generate best\-in\-class risk\-adjusted returns for its clients.
 



  





**Role Summary** 




  





 Lunate is seeking an Associate to join its GP Partnerships team. The team focuses on sourcing, evaluating, executing, and managing strategic investments and partnerships with leading general partners (GPs) and alternative asset managers globally. The Associate will support the full investment lifecycle across opportunities including GP Stakes, LP\-led and GP\-led secondaries, and structured/special situations tied to private market manager ecosystems.
 



 This is an execution\-oriented role with meaningful responsibility from day one—ideal for a candidate with 2–4 years of relevant investing or transaction experience and strong financial analysis, commercial judgment, and stakeholder management skills.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 1\) Deal Sourcing \& Pipeline Development
 


* Support origination efforts by identifying priority GP/manager targets across strategies (PE, VC, credit, real assets, infrastructure, private equity secondaries, etc.).
* Track industry themes (fundraising environment, secondary pricing, GP balance sheet needs, succession planning, monetization, fee\-related earnings dynamics).
* Help prepare outreach materials and manage interaction cadence with bankers, intermediaries, placement agents, GPs, and institutional LPs.
* Maintain pipeline hygiene in CRM and produce weekly/monthly pipeline reporting.



  





 2\) Investment Evaluation \& Due Diligence
 


* Build and review financial models (cash flows, FRE/earnings, valuation, waterfalls, secondary pricing, sensitivities).
* Analyze GP business fundamentals: AUM composition, fee streams, carry potential, fundraising visibility, client concentration, team economics, and operating leverage.
* Conduct market mapping and comps work across GP stake transactions, secondaries, and relevant public/private benchmarks.
* Coordinate diligence workstreams (commercial, financial, legal, tax, compliance, operations) and manage data\-room processes.
* Draft and iterate key materials: investment memos, IC decks, diligence summaries, and risk assessments.



  





 3\) Transaction Execution \& Structuring
 


* Support deal structuring across minority stake investments, preferred equity/structured solutions, stapled secondaries, continuation vehicles, and other partnership constructs.
* Assist in negotiating key economic and governance terms (valuation, distribution mechanics, consent rights, information rights, alignment and retention arrangements).
* Work closely with internal and external legal counsel on term sheets and transaction documentation.
* Drive timelines, deliverables, and cross\-functional coordination through signing and closing.



  





 4\) Portfolio \& Partnership Management
 


* Support ongoing monitoring of partnership investments: performance tracking, quarterly reviews, valuation support, and board/observer materials where applicable.
* Help evaluate follow\-on opportunities (co\-investments, continuation solutions, additional stake purchases, liquidity options).
* Contribute to relationship management with partner GPs and internal stakeholders.



  





**Experience and Qualifications** 




  




* 2–4 years of relevant experience in one or more of the following:
* GP Stakes investing (minority investments into asset managers)
* LP Secondaries (portfolio acquisitions, fund interests, structured secondaries)
* Special Opportunities / Structured Private Markets (complex transactions, preferred equity, NAV financing adjacent, hybrids)
* Investment banking (relevant coverage) with strong buyside\-relevant execution exposure may be considered
* Demonstrated ability to perform advanced financial analysis and modeling (Excel fluency is essential).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to synthesize complexity into clear “so what” insights.
* High attention to detail, strong project management, and the ability to manage multiple workstreams under time pressure.
* Professional maturity and confidence interacting with senior external counterparties (GPs, bankers, lawyers, advisors).
* Undergraduate degree in finance, economics, engineering, mathematics, or a similarly analytical discipline.

title: Finance Analyst
description:
**The AI\-powered OS** 
**for beauty,**
**wellness** 
**and self\-care**
**About Fresha**
 Fresha is the AI\-powered operating system for the global beauty, wellness and self\-care industry, connecting and powering everything from salons and barbers to spas, medspas, fitness studios and health practices.
   

  

 Trusted by millions of consumers and businesses worldwide. Fresha is used by 140,000\+ businesses and 450,000\+ stylists and professionals worldwide, processing over 1 billion appointments to date.
   

  

 The company is headquartered in London, United Kingdom, with 15 global offices located across North America, EMEA and APAC.
   

  

 Fresha allows consumers to discover, book and pay for beauty and wellness appointments with local businesses via its marketplace, while beauty and wellness businesses and professionals use an all\-in\-one platform to manage their entire operations with an intuitive business software and financial technology solutions.
   

  

 Fresha’s ecosystem gives merchants everything they need to run their business seamlessly by facilitating appointment bookings, point\-of\-sale, customer records management, marketing automation, loyalty, beauty products inventory and team management.
   

  

 The consumer marketplace unlocks revenue potential for partner businesses by leveraging the power of online bookings and automated marketing through mobile apps and advanced integrations with major tech brands including Instagram, Facebook and Google.
   

  

**The Role**
 This is a high\-impact individual contributor role that bridges Finance and data. You will be the primary owner of all quantitative inputs that drive Finance operations — from board and investor reporting to unit economics and budgeting. You will work directly in the data warehouse, own the Finance reporting calendar, and partner closely with Analytics, Finance Ops, and senior leadership.
   

  

 The role is critical to how Finance operates at Fresha. You will not be producing reports in the background — you will be the person leadership turns to when they need a number, a model, or an answer.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Financial \& Investor Reporting**
* Own the data inputs for quarterly board packs, investor reports, and investor\-related deliverables
* Prepare and maintain the reporting calendar for all external and internal Finance outputs
* Build and maintain partner, revenue, and gross profit retention schedules — GRR and NRR across any period
* Ensure all Finance inputs to Commercial Performance Update (CPU) decks are accurate, complete, and submitted on time


**Unit Economics \& Modelling**
* Own deal\-level unit economics by country: forecast revenue, gross profit, and contribution margin
* Maintain and evolve the attribution model across Organic, Marketing, and Direct Sales channels
* Build and maintain cohort\-level financial models, including CAC, LTV, and payback period
* Construct operating and financial models to evaluate strategic opportunities and present findings to senior stakeholders


**Finance Operations**
* Provide Finance Ops with all required data extracts to support month\-end close, reconciliations, and audits
* Maintain and update the financial model used for budgeting and forecasting; pull actuals and provide variance analysis
* Identify and flag data anomalies proactively before they surface in reporting


**Data \& Analytics Partnership**
* Work directly in the data warehouse to extract, validate, and maintain Finance\-required datasets
* Partner with Data Engineering to ensure Finance metrics are correctly defined and available in the right tables
* Drive adoption of data\-driven decision\-making across commercial and Finance functions


**What We're Looking For**
**Essential**
* 4\+ years in financial analysis, commercial finance, or a data\-heavy strategy role at a high\-growth technology company
* Direct experience supporting investor or board reporting \- you understand what a board pack requires and why it matters
* Hands\-on SQL skills: you can write your own queries, not just interpret other people's outputs
* Experience building unit economics models (CAC, LTV, payback, cohort analysis) from scratch
* Exposure to marketplace or SaaS business models and the metrics that matter (GMV, take rate, net revenue retention, partner economics)
* Strong attention to detail with ability to reconcile data across multiple sources and spot when something is off
* Comfortable presenting analysis directly to senior stakeholders \- executive and director level
* Degree in Finance, Economics, or a related field


**Strongly Preferred**
* Previous experience at a VC\- or PE\-backed tech company; familiarity with investor relations and the cadence of reporting obligations that come with institutional backing
* Python or equivalent for data manipulation and automation


**Good to Have**
* Professional qualification: CFA, CMA, ACCA, or equivalent
* Experience with M\&A or due diligence processes; familiarity with corporate documents


**Inclusive workforce**
 At Fresha, we are creating a culture where individuals of all backgrounds feel comfortable.
   

  

 We want all Fresha people to feel included and truly empowered to contribute fully to our vision and goals. Everyone who applies will receive fair consideration for employment.
   

  

 We do not discriminate based on race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Trading Operations Analyst
description:
**About us**




  





 Aquanow is a trading and technology company powering the next generation of financial services. We’re at the forefront of the rapidly evolving digital asset space, empowering businesses to navigate the complexities of cryptocurrencies and blockchain technologies. As a leading provider of infrastructure solutions, we offer innovative services in cryptocurrency trading, liquidity management, and secure digital asset storage. Our platform is built to deliver seamless, scalable, and reliable solutions that cater to the needs of institutional clients and businesses seeking to unlock the potential of digital finance. Aquanow is committed to driving growth and shaping the future of the digital economy by offering unparalleled opportunities for innovation and advancement in the world of digital assets.
 



  





 With rapid global expansion, we have established offices in Vancouver, Toronto, Dubai, Malaysia, Turkey, and beyond. Our international customer base includes some of the world’s fastest\-growing fintech companies and leading financial institutions.
 



  





**Your Contribution to Our Growth**




  





 We are seeking a well\-rounded individual to join our global trading team in our Dubai office. The trading operations team provides global 24/7 coverage for our clients and is responsible for delivering timely and accurate service across our traded products.
 



  





 As a Trading Operations Analyst, you will gain an in\-depth understanding of how a modern financial services firm operates. This role combines structured operational work with real\-time trading support, requiring both precision and the ability to think quickly. A core part of the role is owning high\-impact workflows like settlements and fund movements, where precision, consistency, and attention to detail are critical. You’ll also be expected to understand the “why” behind processes, applying sound judgment and raising questions when something doesn’t align.
 



  





 This is a balanced role with exposure to both client\-facing support and behind\-the\-scenes operations, working closely with global teams across regions in a fast\-paced environment where processes evolve quickly.
 



  





 This role operates within a global coverage model. As part of a predefined schedule, you may be required to work weekends and public holidays, with days off provided in lieu. Schedules will be shared in advance, and any changes will be clearly communicated.
 



  





 We are open to candidates from a wide range of educational and professional backgrounds. If you are motivated, curious, and eager to challenge yourself in a fast\-paced environment, this is a strong opportunity to build a career in trading operations.
 



  





 This is a full\-time, permanent position based in our Dubai office, with a hybrid working model.
 



  





**What You’ll Do**




  




* Execute daily settlements, ensuring trades are completed accurately across fiat and digital assets.
* Manage fund movements between bank accounts, internal systems, and custodian wallets.
* Process deposits, withdrawals, refunds, and other transaction\-related activities.
* Perform reconciliations and maintain accurate records of all transactions and balances.
* Monitor transactions and identify discrepancies or issues, escalating when necessary.
* Take ownership of operational workflows and flag issues proactively when something doesn’t align.
* Respond to client queries in a timely and professional manner in accordance with company policies and guidelines.
* Manage and record client requests through internal ticketing systems, ensuring timely and accurate resolution.
* Ensure client\-facing activities are routed quickly and efficiently, and escalated when necessary.
* Troubleshoot issues, provide product information, and guide clients through common problems and setup.
* Work closely with internal partners and teams across regions to ensure smooth end\-to\-end execution.
* Ensure all operational documentation is accurate and kept up to date.
* Support the preparation of internal and client\-facing reports and presentations.
* Contribute to process improvements and support ad\-hoc operational and project\-based tasks.



  





**We’d Love to See**




  




* Bachelor’s degree (ideally in Finance, Economics, Business, Accounting, etc.).
* Analytical skills and the ability to think through problems.
* Positive attitude with high aptitude to learn new things.
* Team player with capacity to work in an unstructured work environment.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office, SQL, VBA, etc.
* Basic programming experience and interested in developing these skills.
* Seeking an opportunity to grow within a high\-growth organization.
* Flexible schedule and the ability to work holidays and weekends.



  





 At our offices you will find a group of people that embrace diversity and value performance over pedigree. Every day we draw value from the diverse experiences of our team whose backgrounds include top financial institutions, tech companies, and non\-traditional backgrounds. Our success comes from identifying exceptional people and providing them with the platform to reach their true potential.
 



  





 Aquanow is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity to all qualified persons without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, national origin, citizenship status, disability, qualified veteran status, marital status, gender identity or any other unlawful criterion or circumstance.
